There's this bloke who owes me a proper stack. Flash little tosser, always throwing his weight around, but when it's time to pay up, he's vanished. Been overdue for ages. Find him and have a proper word with him. You're good at that sort of thing. Last they saw the muppet, he was holed up in the downtown hotel on the second floor. Oh, one more thing. I need you to check out the flat that used to belong to the warden of the local "private" prison. You're heading that way anyway, so swing by while you're at it. And see if you can dig up the key to the cells as well.}} ==Requirements== * This quest is only obtainable by [[BEAR]] PMCs. * Must reach Loyalty Level 2 with [[Skier]] to obtain this quest. ==Objectives== * Locate the debtor on [[Streets of Tarkov]] * Locate the private [[Chekannaya 15 apartment key|prison warden's apartment]] on [[Streets of Tarkov]] * Hand over the item: [[Iron gate key]] ==Rewards== * +10,000 [[EXP]] * [[Skier]] Rep '''+0.25''' * 1,000 Euros ** 1,050 Euros with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1 ** 1,150 Euros with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2 {{quote|What, straight through him with a crowbar? No bloody way! Damn, my luck's been absolutely terrible lately.}} ==Initial Equipment== {| class="wikitable" !Icon !Item name !Amount !Notes |- |[[File:Chekannaya 15 apartment key icon.png|link=Chekannaya 15 apartment key]] |[[Chekannaya 15 apartment key]] |1 |Key to the prison warden's apartment |} ==Guide== {| class="wikitable" ! colspan="6" |Related Quest Items |- !Icon !Item name !Amount !Requirement !'''[[Found in raid|Find in raid]]''' !Notes |- |[[File:Chekannaya 15 apartment key icon.png|link=Chekannaya 15 apartment key]] |[[Chekannaya 15 apartment key]] |1 |Required !N/A |Used to open the prison warden's apartment |- |[[File:Iron gate key icon.png|link=Iron gate key]] |[[Iron gate key]] |1 |Handover item !No | |} In this quest you first have to find the debtor on [[Streets of Tarkov]]. He can be found in room 206 on the second floor of the northern Pinewood hotel building. The room does not require a key.

    • Next you have to find the prison warden's apartment. The apartment is located in the Chekannaya 15 apartment building on [[Streets of Tarkov]]. A [[Chekannaya 15 apartment key]] is required to enter the apartment. The wanted apartment is the easternmost one on the second floor. It can only be accessed via the western staircase from the third floor through a hole in the floor of cell #5. The debris in the second floor hallway can only be passed by proning.
